    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Markers above/below frame define a two-by-two quadrant coloring.
    n = len(grid)
    coords = [(r,c) for r in range(n) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] not in (0,5)]
    if not coords:
        return out
    marker = {grid[r][c]:(r,c) for r,c in coords}
    colors = list(marker)
    # Interior is partitioned into four equal rectangles; colors alternate by diagonal.
    rs = [r for r in range(n) if any(grid[r][c] == 5 for c in range(len(grid[0])))]
    cs = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(n))]
    top,bottom=min(rs),max(rs); left,right=min(cs),max(cs)
    midr=(top+bottom)//2; midc=(left+right)//2
    # Apply alternating checker pattern, starting upper-left with left-side marker color.
    upper = [x for x in colors if marker[x][0] < top]
    lower = [x for x in colors if marker[x][0] > bottom]
    order = upper if upper else lower
    if len(order)>=2:
        a,b=order[0],order[1]
    else:
        a,b=colors[0],colors[-1]
    for r in range(top+1,bottom):
        for c in range(left+1,right):
